kv12.10:1.4: sattamabhaviko puggalo nirayaṃ upapajjeyya, tiracchānayoniṃ upapajjeyya, pettivisayaṃ upapajjeyyā’ti.
kv12.10:1.6: tena hi sattamabhavikassa puggalassa pahīnā duggatī’ti.
kv12.10:2.1: saṃvaro kammaṃ tatheva asaṃvaro sabbaṃ kammaṃ savipākaṃ saddo vipāko saḷāyatanaṃ vipāko sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatā niyato kolaṃkolo puggalo kolaṃkolatāniyato ekabījī puggalo ekabījitāniyato diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyya diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggati tatheva sattamabhavikassā’ti. terasamo vaggo.
